name: Shiv
description: Shiv is the red desert and mountain region of Dominaria where the Mana Rig stands.

description_citations.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

summary.text: Shiv is the red desert and mountain region of Dominaria where the Mana Rig stands.

citations.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

bio.text: Shiv is located in Dominaria, and Jhoira's workshop and the Mana Rig lie there.

citations.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

bio.text: Jhoira noted that Teferi later returned Shiv and lost his planeswalker spark doing so.

citations.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

status.text: The material's last events give no change to Shiv, which remains in Dominaria as the home of the Mana Rig.

citations.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Urza settles on Shiv by making peace with Gherridarigaaz and persuading goblins to work with viashino; the Rig produces powerstones for his Legacy.
timeline.quote: managed to settle with the viashino living by the Rig by making peace with the dragon Gherridarigaaz

citation.text: "Shiv", section "Urza". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Dominarian viashino survive the Ice Age by hiding within the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: the viashino survived the Ice Age by hiding within the Mana Rig

citation.text: "Viashino", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Viashino, goblins, Ghitu and Shivan dragons form the Shivan Nation.
timeline.quote: The four species have now formed the Shivan Nation together.

citation.text: "Viashino", section "Dominaria". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jhoira leaves the Ghitu of Shiv to learn artifice.
timeline.quote: Jhoira left her people to learn more about artifice

citation.text: "Jhoira", section "History". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza travels to Shiv, makes peace among the Viashino, goblins and dragons and puts them to work on the Thran Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: He makes peace between the local Viashino , Goblins , and fire dragons

citation.text: "Time Streams", section "Story". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The set's story follows Urza as he travels the planes seeking weapons to destroy the dark forces that stalk him.
timeline.quote: he travels the planes seeking weapons to destroy the dark forces that stalk him

citation.text: "Urza's Saga", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Jhoira and Karn's help, Urza surveys the Thran Mana Rig in Shiv and uncovers its primary purpose.
timeline.quote: With the assistance of his student Jhoira and Karn , the silver golem , Urza surveys the Thran Mana Rig in Shiv and uncovers its primary purpose.

citation.text: "Urza's Legacy", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tevesh Szat tells Darigaaz the legend of the Primeval Dragons and shows him the destroyed red Primeval's corpse in Shiv, saying the others can be awakened to aid the war.
timeline.quote: He showed Darigaaz the corpse of the red Primeval in Shiv

citation.text: "Darigaaz", section "Original Incarnation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Sixty years after the Mending, a new Darigaaz hatches from an egg, lives among the Ghitu, and becomes champion of the dragons of Shiv.
timeline.quote: This Darigaaz hatched from an egg found in a temporal rift

citation.text: "Darigaaz", section "Reincarnation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi phases out part of Shiv, leaving a hole in Dominaria.
timeline.quote: leaving a hole in Dominaria.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Shivan rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi heals the Shivan rift, the first to close, sacrificing his spark.
timeline.quote: Teferi successfully healed the damage, sacrificing his spark in the process.

citation.text: "Rift", section "Shivan rift". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jhoira uses the Rig against the Phyrexians; Teferi phases a chunk of Shiv out with Jhoira and part of the Rig.
timeline.quote: Teferi phased out a large chunk of Shiv along with Jhoira and part of the Mana Rig

citation.text: "Shiv", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rhammidarigaaz discovers his origin and begins awakening the other dragons.
timeline.quote: discovered his origin and started awakening the other dragons

citation.text: "Shiv", section "Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tevesh Szat tells Darigaaz about the primevals; Darigaaz sets out to save the others.
timeline.quote: but Darigaaz sets out to save the others nonetheless.

citation.text: "Planeshift (novel)", section "Summary". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Shiv is phased out during the Phyrexian Invasion.
timeline.quote: her homeland was phased out along with Teferi's

citation.text: "Jhoira", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jhoira and Teferi return to Dominaria; Teferi gives up his spark to seal the rift over Shiv while Jhoira secretly holds his spark in a powerstone.
timeline.quote: Teferi gave up his planeswalker's spark to seal the time rift over Shiv

citation.text: "Jhoira", section "Fighting the Phyrexians". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Rorix Bladewing and other dragons strive to rebuild Shiv.
timeline.quote: In the smoldering ashes of Shiv, a few dragons strive to rebuild their native land.

citation.text: Rorix Bladewing (Onslaught, 2002), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: During the Fall of the Primevals, Averru traps the red Primeval Rhammidarigaaz beneath a caldera in Shiv and gains the dragon's powers.
timeline.quote: Averru trapped the red Primeval Rhammidarigaaz beneath a caldera in Shiv

citation.text: "Averru", section "Ancient Dominion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi seals the time rift over Shiv at the cost of his spark.
timeline.quote: sealing the time rift over Shiv at the cost of his Planeswalker's Spark

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Rift Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi returns Shiv to its whole form at the expense of his spark.
timeline.quote: at the expense of his planeswalker's spark

citation.text: "Shiv", section "Rift Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ghitu and goblins fight over the Rig; Jhoira negotiates a truce and repairs it.
timeline.quote: Jhoira negotiated a truce and managed to repair the Mana Rig

citation.text: "Shiv", section "Rift Era". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi phases Zhalfir and Shiv out of the timestream to protect them during the Phyrexian Invasion, tearing localized rifts.
timeline.quote: who removed large regions of the plane from the timestream to protect them

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Causes". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi, helped by Jhoira, restores Shiv to the timeline and seals the rift, sacrificing his spark and becoming mortal.
timeline.quote: sacrificing his spark and becoming mortal

citation.text: "Temporal Crisis of Dominaria", section "Resolution". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: With Shiv's return imminent, Teferi and Jhoira return to Dominaria seeking information and aid, finding it nearly devoid of mana.
timeline.quote: Teferi first stops in Skyshroud but is horrified to learn that Dominaria is almost completely devoid of mana

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi channels all his life force into the Shivan rift to close it; Shiv phases in safely but Teferi loses his spark and becomes mortal.
timeline.quote: Teferi is sapped of his planeswalker spark and is now mortal.

citation.text: "Time Spiral (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi, Jhoira and Venser restore the wayward region of Shiv to its natural place in Dominaria, healing one rift.
timeline.quote: he has already succeeded in restoring the wayward region of Shiv to its natural place in Dominaria, healing one rift.

citation.text: "Planar Chaos", section "Flavor and storyline". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Teferi has sealed the rift over Shiv, returning the continent, but is drained of all powers; Jhoira and Venser take him to the Ghitu, who help Venser build a new ambulator.
timeline.quote: However, the effort has drained the planeswalker of all his powers and left him incapacitated.

citation.text: "Planar Chaos (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Four planeswalkers pursue one another from plane to plane, wielding realities like weapons.
timeline.quote: The four planeswalkers pursued one another from plane to plane, wielding realities like weapons

citation.text: "The Planes of Planechase". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Teferi phased Shiv fully back into Dominaria at the cost of his planeswalker spark.
timeline.quote: Recently phased fully back into Dominaria by Teferi at the cost of his planeswalker spark

citation.text: "The Planes of Planechase". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: The Thran used Shiv as the site of the immense Mana Rig, source of powerstones.
timeline.quote: who used it as a site of the immense Mana Rig, source of the powerstones that powered their civilization

citation.text: "The Planes of Planechase". Savor the Flavor, Wizards of the Coast, 31 Aug 2009. Archived by the Internet Archive.

timeline.summary: Jhoira notes Teferi later returned Shiv and lost his planeswalker spark doing so.
timeline.quote: That's how he lost his Planeswalker spark.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 6" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Teferi questions whether his decision to hide Zhalfir was self-serving.
timeline.quote: Teferi wasn't sure why Zhalfir had been so much on his mind since he'd given up his spark.

citation.text: "Return to Dominaria: Episode 7" by Martha Wells. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Apr 2018.

timeline.summary: Jhoira and Darigaaz form the Shivan Nation in 4520 AR.
timeline.quote: she was instrumental in forming the Shivan Nation in 4520 AR

citation.text: "Shiv", section "Shivan Nation". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vivien planeswalks from Ixalan to Shiv.
timeline.quote: before she flashed into the next plane and felt the hard, hot air of Shiv on her skin

citation.text: "Unbowed, Part 3" by Cassandra Khaw. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 7 Sep 2018.

timeline.summary: Krenko accepts a job from Mr. Taz to raid the Boros guildhall and is given a glowing shiv.
timeline.quote: Mr. Taz gave Krenko a tool specially made for that job.

citation.text: "Krenko", section "Working for Mr. Taz". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During a goblin gang war Krenko kills Dargig and is arrested by Gideon Jura, injuring him with the shiv.
timeline.quote: Krenko killed Dargig, the youngest of the Shattergang Brothers

citation.text: "Krenko", section "In and out of prison". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Vivien planeswalks away to seek the dragons of Shiv, leaving Luneau to the beasts and humans.
timeline.quote: She planeswalked away, leaving Luneau to the beasts and humans.

citation.text: "Luneau", section "Notable locations". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The planeswalker and Squee infiltrate Omek's fortress and kill the pretender Kedu; Omek abdicates.
timeline.quote: Together, they infiltrated Omek's fortress, killed the pretender to the throne, Kedu, and defeated Omek's soldiers.

citation.text: "The Traveler", section "Shiv". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Hero rids Old Onkoom of goblins and earns the title Hero of Old Onkoom.
timeline.quote: The hero's victory earned them the title Hero of Old Onkoom .

citation.text: "The Traveler", section "Shiv". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Hero assassinates Kyashatar and frees Darigaaz.
timeline.quote: Within Kyashatar's lair, the Hero assassinated the dragon broodmother and councilmember.

citation.text: "The Traveler", section "Shiv". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Hero slays Gavon Deniz and deactivates the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: The Hero dueled and slew Deniz, then deactivated the Rig.

citation.text: "The Traveler", section "Shiv". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Josu Vess has Kyashatar reanimated, and the Traveler slays the revenant.
timeline.quote: The Traveler then slew the reanimated Kyashatar, and Darigaaz saw to his proper burial.

citation.text: "The Traveler", section "Shiv". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Darigaaz destroys a Phyrexian monster attacking the Weatherlight over Shiv and accepts Teferi's proposal to fight.
timeline.quote: "I accept your proposal to fight here at Shiv.

citation.text: "Episode 4: A Brutal Blow" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 15 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Darigaaz and the dragons dive at the Weatherlight and rake its cables.
timeline.quote: Darigaaz threw himself at the Weatherlight 's hull

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Jhoira wakes the Mana Rig, which stands and tears free, strides across the desert and floods the Phyrexians with lava.
timeline.quote: The Mana Rig was free.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Magnigoths and Yavimayan elves arrive and drive the Phyrexians back; Jodah and Meria land on the deck on a kavu and Jodah shields the cannons.
timeline.quote: rank upon rank of Magnigoths marched forward, darkening Shiv's deserts with their cool shadows and verdant foliage.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi and Jhoira organize the survivors, and Jodah, holding Karn's necklace and a lock of Jaya's hair, mourns her.
timeline.quote: I can't let go of her. I just got her back again.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: Teferi, Jodah and Jhoira build a monument to Jaya in Shiv's desert; Teferi leaves an empty pyramid for Karn.
timeline.quote: Jodah, Teferi, and Jhoira had remained to build this: a monument for Jaya.

citation.work: Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind
citation.text: "Episode 5: A Whisper in the Wind" by Langley Hyde. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 18 Aug 2022.

timeline.summary: After a winged Phyrexian attacks the Weatherlight, Darigaaz and the dragons join the New Coalition and fight in the Battle of the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: He was present and fought in the Battle of the Mana Rig

citation.text: "Darigaaz", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Coalition clashes with Sheoldred's army at the Battle of the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: the two armies clashed at the Battle of the Mana Rig on Shiv

citation.text: "Dominaria (plane)", section "Second Phyrexian Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Jhoira gives the Weatherlight to Shanna Sisay and returns to the Mana Rig.
timeline.quote: Jhoira handed the Weatherlight over to Shanna Sisay

citation.text: "Jhoira", section "Dominaria United". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Tezzeret enters Shiv's cave complex and brutally forces Rona to give a status report.
timeline.quote: I've been told that unprotected flesh takes a few seconds to vaporize in the Blind Eternities.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: Rona reports the Phyrexians' losses and that the Planeswalkers have been tracked to New Argive.
timeline.quote: But we have been able to track them back to New Argive.

citation.text: "The Brothers' War | Chapter 3: Nemesis" by Reinhardt Suarez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 25 Oct 2022.

timeline.summary: The New Phyrexians use Cometia Crater as a staging ground, attack the Mana Rig, then strike Urza's Tower in New Argive.
timeline.quote: before launching their attack on Shiv's Mana Rig

citation.text: "Shiv", section "Second Invasion". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza gathers reinforcements on Shiv.
timeline.quote: Teleporting to Shiv , Urza gathered reinforcements

citation.text: "Invasion of Tolaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza convinces Gherridarigaaz to fight by promising to reunite her with her son.
timeline.quote: convinced her to fight by promising to reunite her with her son, Rhammidarigaaz.

citation.text: "Invasion of Tolaria", section "Description". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.
